The length and the breadth of a rectangle are 12 cm and (13 + r) cm respectively. If the length of a diagonal of the rectangle is (7 – 2r) cm, find r. (3 marks)
Solution
12^{2} + (13 + r)^{2} = (7 – 2r)^{2}   (1M)
144 + 169 + 26r + r^{2} = 49 – 28r + 4r^{2}
3r^{2} – 54r – 264 = 0 (1M: for ar^{2} + br + c = 0)
r^{2} – 18r – 88 = 0
(r + 4)(r – 22) = 0
r + 4 = 0  or  r – 22  = 0
r = –4 or  r = 22  (rejected) (1A)
Thus, we have r = –4.

rows: [HKDSE Sample Paper 2 Q6]

Let a be a constant. Solve the equation (x + a)(x – a – 2) = (x + a).
A. x = a + 2
B. x = a + 3
C. x = –a  or  x = a + 2
D. x = –a  or  x = a + 3
Solution
(x + a)(x – a – 2) = (x + a)
(x + a)(x – a – 2) – (x + a) = 0
(x + a)(x – a – 2 – 1) = 0
x + a = 0 or x – a – 2 – 1 = 0
x = –a or x = a + 3
∴ The answer is D.

[HKDSE 2022 Paper 2 Q35]

Let z = 19 – ki^{9} + 2ki^{14} – 6i^{20} – 11i^{23}, where k is a real number. If the real part and the imaginary part of z are equal, then the real part of z is
A. –8.
B. –3.
C. 2.
D. 9.
Solution
19 – ki^{9} + 2ki^{14} – 6i^{20} – 11i^{23}
= 19 – k(i) + 2k(–1) – 6(1) – 11(–i) →
= (13 – 2k) + (–k + 11)i
∴ 13 – 2k = –k + 11
k = 2       → Do not forget to find the real part of z.
∴ Real part of z = 13 – 2(2) = 9
∴ The answer is D.
